newsitem.title: USA: NASD orders ex-Stratton officers pay damages - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: NASD orders ex-Stratton officers pay damages - WSJ.

text.p: A National Association of Securities Dealers arbitration panel ordered four former officers of brokerage Stratton Oakmont to pay a California doctor $10 million in punitive damages, the Wall Street Journal said in Thursday's electronic edition.
The doctor, F. Clark Gardner, alleged former Stratton broker Samuel Weber recommended investments which were not suitable and made unauthorized transactions in his account, the newspaper said.
According to newsletter Securities Arbitration Commentator, the award was the largest ever made in customer arbitration, the newspaper said.
